name: LaBeau's (Garden City, UT) Famous Golden Fried Halibut Basket & Fries
whyItWorks: LaBeau's famous golden halibut is tender and flaky. Halibut is naturally low-fat and easy to absorb. Tartar sauce served on the side.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Halibut Basket with tartar sauce on the side; peel off outer crispy batter if digestive sensitivity is active.
watchOuts: Remove outer fried crust during active digestive symptoms
